description.en: The rules of scanning and installing patches for the specified operating system.

description.zh: 批准补丁是否包括除安全性之外的更新
description.en: Specifies whether the approved patch involves updates other than security-related updates.
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.
The description of the patch baseline.
The name of the patch baseline.

description.zh:
操作系统类型。支持：
- Windows
- Ubuntu
- CentOS
- Debian
- AliyunLinux
- RedhatEnterpriseLinux
- Anolis
- AlmaLinux
description.en:
The type of the operating system. Valid values:

*   Windows
*   Ubuntu
*   CentOS
*   Debian
*   AliyunLinux
*   RedhatEnterpriseLinux
*   Anolis
*   AlmaLinux
The ID of the region in which you want to create a patch baseline.
The action of the rejected patch.
The ID of the resource group.
